- **T2 result:** alphafold T2 at n = 500 has a width ratio of 1.0043 against the package, "no gain". Against the unclipped baseline it is 1.0020. Side information X gives no gain on any of the four T2 sets at the reference n.
- **Counts:** the headline now has 55 rows: T1 has 39 "no gain" and 12 "small / undecided", and T2 has 4 "no gain". No row is a gain.

- **Paper text:** `paper-repo` `dev` has no "54" or "three T2" wording that needs fixing; I grepped the `.tex` files.

No results are outstanding. What remains is the text, tracked in `paper-repo`#3, and review.
